summary: Updated the invoke_next plan sections to require passing stdout: process.stderr when calling runWorkOnViaCrew so helper output cannot corrupt MCP stdout.
Updated both list_blockers predicates to use Object.values(reviewOpenCount ?? {}).some((n) => (n ?? 0) > 0) and wrote the amended plan to the requested .tmp file.
Added get_task taskId validation before journal reads, required exporting assertSafeTaskId for reuse, and documented the path-traversal guard rule.
Added pnpm-lock.yaml to the plan's modify list and added frozen-lockfile verification to the acceptance criteria and verification section.
Updated US-010 references from plans/ralph-pipeline-10-handoff.md to the verified plans/ralph-pipeline-10-ralph-handoff.md path.
Amended the plan so list_crew_sessions defines a local LiveCrewSession response and re-reads matching manifests to merge live heartbeat and state fields while leaving shared CrewSessionRef unchanged.
